updates.change: Revised inlet and therefore surrounding to meet chassis and floor.
updates.how: To ingest higher pressure air to the sidepod inlet from upstream, the profile has been revised based upon simulation and initial running results yielding improved efficiency

updates.change: Surfaces adapted to meet the new sidepod inlet geometry
updates.how: As a consequence of the inlet changes, the sidepods have been revised to suit and offer an efficiency improvement for cooling and downstream surfaces.

updates.change: Upper surface revised to meet new sidepod
updates.how: Consequential changes to meet new sidepod geometry and extending forward to the chassis, benefitting from the efficiency to offer more load.
Given the braking energy demands of Suzuka, minor changes have been made to the rear wheel bodywork to suit the brake material requirements.

updates.change: Reduced front brake duct inboard exit area
updates.how: The Suzuka Circuit braking duty allows us to introduce a smaller front brake duct geometry, trading off brake cooling for external aerodynamic performance benefits

updates.change: Revised front floor stay fairing profile
updates.how: Minor geometrical update and not specific to this event, the reprofiling of the front floor stay fairing improves local flow features and returns floor performance gains

updates.change: Compared to the launch car, a revised set of suspension claddings are available to package efficiently around the updated suspension structures.
updates.how: The incidence and profiles of the external claddings have been optimised to work effectively with the new internal suspension structures to ensure that the impact on the downstream flow field is mitigated.

updates.change: The chord of the 3rd front wing profile is shorter in conjunction with a reduced length strake.
updates.how: In conjunction with the front wing endplate change the modifications improve the load distribution at the outboard end of the wing.

updates.change: The edge of the outboard footplate is raised.
updates.how: In conjunction with the front wing change the modifications improve the load distribution at the outboard end of the wing.

updates.change: The floor leading edge devices have been revised.
updates.how: The new floor leading edge devices modify the spanwise generation of load across the width of the floor to improve performance.

updates.change: The FW SM actuation system was simplified allowing smaller exposed geometries
updates.how: The FW SM linkage was simplified, enabling a reduced external envelope. The smaller linkages decrease blockage and consequently improve the airflow directed towards the rear of the car.
The front deflector has been redesigned to improve the management of the local flowfield, ensuring a consistent delivery of performance throughout the entire operating range.

updates.change: SM pod fairing and reprofiled elements
updates.how: Local adjustments have been made to the rear wing to extract more performance out of it, both in Cornering and in Straight mode.

updates.change: Re-designed of the lower part of the Rear Wing Endplate
updates.how: The end plate has been redesigned to improve the flow conditioning at the rear of the car while also generating local load.

updates.change: Lower edge detail change on diffuser fence
updates.how: The diffuser fence has been redesigned with a lower profile to enhance overall ride height behaviour and improve aerodynamic performance across the operating envelope.

updates.change: Updated central diffuser trailing edge profile
updates.how: The trailing edge profile of the diffuser has been revised and optimized to enhance overall performance and increase overall rear aerodynamic load.
